title: Box, Divider, Spacer, Grid — layout primitives, verified in a real browser

environment.profile: p3web — isolated DSH_HOME at tmp/dsh-p3 on :3093; production desktop (:61582) untouched
environment.card: drawn by the model through the visualize tool; no DOM injected by the harness

bundleCheckPerAgentsRule9.outcome: MATCH on both halves, re-verified after the final rebuild and again before the closing measurements.

summary.gate: 9 items — 8 verified, 1 recorded as not verified with its reason

exitGate.item: Box, Divider, Spacer, Grid all have a real renderer
exitGate.detail: All four draw; the inventory (tests/openui-inventory.spec.tsx) reads RENDERED_COMPONENTS from the renderer itself, not a hand-kept list: 12 / 48.

exitGate.item: Component arguments match the signature table
exitGate.detail: Argument order was read from signatures.ts (Box: children, direction, gap, padding, background, radius, border, width, height, flex, align, justify, wrap; Grid: children, columns, minChildWidth, gap) and every position is asserted in tests/openui-layout-4a1.spec.tsx.

exitGate.item: Every component CSS variable resolves in the real DSH host
exitGate.verdict: PASS — after fixing two defects it found
exitGate.detail: The probe checks three layers: the variable is referenced, it is declared on the card root, and the host token it names resolves on document.body. First run: 0 of 24 unresolved in light, but 2 in dark — see defects D17/D18. After the fix both themes report 0 unresolved (probe-light-fixed.json, probe-dark-final.json).

Dark was entered through the host's own Settings → 通用设置 → 外观 → 深色 control (a1-s22-switch.mjs: data-ds-dark-theme false→true, color-scheme light→dark) and the measurements were taken under it. No host CSS was modified at any point.

exitGate.item: Tool View and Turn Tail both display
exitGate.detail: 2 copies of the card, 1 inside the fold and 1 on the tail, at 362px and 367px respectively — see replay.txt.
After a full reload both copies return with identical layout: same grid tracks, 1px divider, Spacer flex 1 1 0px. The model was not called again.
675 passed / 15 failed / 690, and the 15-item failure set is identical to the baseline (evidence/phase-4a-1/test-4a1.txt vs test-baseline.txt). tsc host and client both exit 0.

exitGate.item: Build SHA-256 matches the test profile
exitGate.detail: Both halves match; see bundleCheckPerAgentsRule9. A mismatch was caught and fixed at the start of the run, which is why the rule exists.

exitGate.item: Test evidence, migration matrix and stage report updated

checks.name: Box nesting: Box containing Row, Col and Text
checks.detail: The first Box holds a Title and a Row of two Texts; the first Grid cell holds a Box with a Text and a Col with a Text + Caption. All three container kinds render inside a Box.

checks.name: Box sizing: fixed width and elastic width
checks.detail: width 240 measured 240px in a 680px card; flex 1 measured 680px in the same card and 367px after the card narrowed. Neither collapsed nor overflowed.

checks.name: Grid responsiveness: columns drop as the card narrows
checks.detail: MinChildWidth 180 grid: 3 columns at 680px and 560px, 2 at 440px, 1 at 320px. The explicit 3-column grid held 3 tracks at every width, so the change is the auto-fit rule and not a global effect.
checks.note: An earlier attempt resized the window instead of the card and produced 527px at every step; that run is kept as a1-s27-responsive.mjs but its result is NOT used.

checks.name: Grid nesting: cells hold complex components
checks.detail: The 2-column grid held a Box (bg danger, radius sm, border 1px solid) and a Col with two children; both measured 334px wide at a 680px card, with the 12px gap.

checks.name: Divider visible in both themes
checks.detail: 1px tall, full card width, painting rgba(0,0,0,0.1) in light and rgba(255,255,255,0.12) in dark; opacity 1, visibility visible in both.

checks.name: Spacer: measured distance between its two neighbours
checks.detail: The Spacer took 589px of a 680px row (flex 1 1 0px), leaving 'before' and 'after' 605px apart; after the card narrowed it took 298px. Without the Spacer the two Texts would sit 8px apart (the row gap).

checks.name: Empty content vs missing renderer
checks.detail: The empty Grid draws as a real grid (display:grid, template 336px 336px, 0 children) and carries no unrendered notice. A declared-but-undrawn component instead renders a visible 'X is not drawn by this build' notice with data-openui-unrendered — pinned by tests so the two cannot become confusable.

checks.name: Both surfaces and replay after refresh
checks.detail: 1 copy inside the fold, 1 on the tail, before and after a full reload, with identical geometry across the reload.

checks.name: History replay across several sessions and older card generations
checks.detail: The isolated profile's original session log cannot be loaded by this host build at all: it contains event type 'job/registered' written by a newer harness, and dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 refuses to interpret it ('历史加载失败'). That session was therefore unavailable for a multi-generation replay. The single-session reload replay (A8) passed; a cross-generation replay needs a session this build can read.
checks.reason: environment — older session log written by a newer harness

defectsFound.defect: `--dsw-static-purple-500` does not exist in the host
defectsFound.impact: `--viz-series-4` resolved to nothing in the real browser and silently painted its fallback; every unit test passed because the fallback is a plausible purple.
defectsFound.found: the three-layer CSS-variable probe, in dark theme
defectsFound.fix: The slot has no host token at all, so it is now declared directly as a literal pair (light-dark) with a comment saying why, instead of naming a token that does not exist.

defectsFound.defect: `--dsh-font-family-text-default` does not exist in the host
defectsFound.impact: `--font-sans` resolved to nothing and fell back to the literal stack; identical-looking text, wrong mechanism.
defectsFound.fix: Reads `--dsw-font-family`, which the host does publish and which resolves to the same system stack. Verified against all 509 custom properties the live host declares (host-tokens.json).

defectsFound.defect: The component inventory mirrored the renderer's table as a hand-written literal
defectsFound.impact: The probe reported 8 / 48 after the renderers existed — it was a copy of an old answer, not a measurement.
defectsFound.found: while regenerating the inventory for this batch
defectsFound.fix: The renderer now exports RENDERED_COMPONENTS, and tests/openui-inventory.spec.tsx asserts against the real table (12 / 48).

screenshots.how: host Settings → 通用设置 → 外观 → 浅色 (verified: data-ds-dark-theme false, color-scheme light)

data-ds-dark-theme set directly, because the click on 深色 was intermittently blocked by the browser-skill extension overlay. Dark-theme MEASUREMENTS (probe-dark.json, probe-dark-final.json) were taken under the host-switched theme via a1-s22-switch.mjs, not under this forced attribute. The image is a faithful dark render; the switch itself is recorded separately so the two are not conflated.

environmentBlockersRecorded.blocker: The batch's first session could not be driven by automation
environmentBlockersRecorded.detail: The host's own conversation pane failed on that session with 'TypeError: text.replace is not a function' in DraftEditorRuntime.setDraft and then could not load the log at all ('job/registered' unknown to this harness). Prompts returned HTTP 200 with nothing painted. This is a host/session defect, not a 4A-1 regression: the same flow worked in a fresh session in the same profile and same build.
environmentBlockersRecorded.resolution: Measurements were taken in a fresh session; the older one is recorded as unreadable rather than as a 4A-1 failure.

environmentBlockersRecorded.detail: protocol skew; the CLI reported version_skew true and every fill crashed the host editor. Updated the CLI to 0.4.1 and restarted the daemon; skew false afterwards.
environmentBlockersRecorded.resolution: fixed before any measurement was recorded
